description: Synthetic CPG data for local ingestion, mapping, and quality demos.

field_notes.currency: Tenant currency with realistic symbol/code variations.
field_notes.discount_pct: Fraction from 0.05 to 0.30, not a whole-number percentage.
field_notes.mapping_ground_truth.csv: Synthetic row-level labels; expected product is retained even when the raw product value is missing.
field_notes.product_catalog_history.csv: Contains an intentional SKU-1001 category change effective 2025-07-01 for visible SCD Type 2 history.
field_notes.retailer_sku / item_number / product_cod: Includes canonical, descriptive, and ontology-synonym product values.
field_notes.transaction_date / ship_date / start_dat: ISO date when valid; selected rows contain not-a-date.
field_notes.units_sold / shipped_quantity / market_u: Raw numeric strings; selected rows contain invalid values.

note: All data and benchmark labels are synthetic and do not represent real customers or measured production performance.
